title: Landing Ground Roll Distance
conditions: Wing flaps 27°, paved/level/dry runway, throttles closed, maximum braking effort, approach speed = 90 MPH IAS, touchdown speed = 70 MPH IAS

exampleCheck.note: Worked example printed on the chart (points A-F). Re-measured directly from reference/fig5-15-landing-ground-roll.png pixel positions on 2026-10-01. TWO prior assumptions were wrong, not just the chart-reading target: the example's pressure altitude is 4000 ft, not the originally assumed 6000 ft (point A's traced curve matches the independently-identified '4000' curve's slope/t0 almost exactly, not '6000's), and its OAT is 70 F, not 65 F (the dashed vertical line sits at pixel x=351.5, which calibrates to ~70 F, not 65 F -- 65 F would be at x=341). Weight (3100 lb) and wind (10 mph headwind) were confirmed correct. weightExponent and windKPerMph were refit from directly-measured B/D/F points (805/700/525). Model now reproduces the chart's worked example to within 0.05% (525.2 computed vs 525 read).

unverifiedAltitudes.note: Only the 4000 ft entry (above) is anchored to the worked example and independently verified to ~0% error. The 0/2000/6000/8000 ft entries were re-traced from the source chart (an improvement on the original guesses) using a shorter, less-anchored pixel baseline (two trace points ~82px apart, then extrapolated out to t0 and t120) and cross-checked by visually confirming each curve against its printed altitude label, but are not confirmed against an independent worked example the way 4000 ft is. Medium confidence, not exact.
